A '''traffic-monitoring scanner''' or '''traffic scanner''' was an automated [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] that logged any violation of ground traffic rules by [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeders]]. The speeder's license number was recorded, which normally resulted in a swift citation and mandatory court appearance for the offender. [[Orron III]] used traffic-monitoring scanners.
